remaining_failure.month_grid_candidate_text: Tap on October 25, the Wednesday after next, to display its scheduled events.

root_cause.summary: r34 fixed relative-date arithmetic but did not bind the computed date to the correct month-grid row or require reversal after the date wheel moved away from the target.
details: The model named October 25 correctly while tapping the coordinate for October 18.
The model then used the date picker but interpreted a downward finger swipe as moving the selected day forward.
Successive screenshots visibly decreased the day value, but the policy continued to claim forward progress.
The appended LOOP_GUARD repair directive was ignored by deterministic decoding and the same swipe was proposed again.
The unchanged guard rejected both candidates without executing a blocked action.

mechanism: In a month grid, locate the first future named weekday and then move one calendar row lower in the same weekday column for 'weekday after next'.
Require visual verification of the target day number before tapping the grid.
Treat date-wheel movement as directional progress only when the visible selected date moves closer to the computed target.
If a swipe moves away from the target, reverse its direction on the next step and never repeat the worsening motion.
Place the LOOP_GUARD repair directive before the original prompt so the bounded repair cannot treat it as a low-salience suffix.
preserved_controls: Same seed, schedule, task instances, step budgets, model-call budgets, evaluator, and acceptance thresholds
No hidden task parameters or evaluator state
